title: Sodium Propionate Alleviates Atopic Dermatitis by Inhibiting Ferroptosis via Activation of LTBP2/FABP4 Signaling Pathway.
summary: The study analyzed the GEO cohort and TNF-α/IFN-γ-induced HaCaT cells; sodium propionate increased loricrin and filaggrin expression in cell experiments. The pathway proposal is based on bioinformatic and in-vitro evidence; clinical treatment efficacy is not established.
ai_technology: Machine-learning target-gene analysis nominated FABP4 with LTBP2 in a study of sodium propionate, ferroptosis and atopic dermatitis.
